mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT c.CATEGORY_ID AS "categoryId", c.CATEGORY_NAME AS "categoryName" FROM QUIZ_SESSIONS qs JOIN SUBJECTS s ON qs.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID JOIN CATEGORIES c ON s.CATEGORY_ID = c.CATEGORY_ID WHERE qs.MEMBER_NUM = #{memberNum} ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_NAME

SELECT q.QUIZ_ID AS "quiz_id", qr.QUIZ_USER_RESPONSE AS "answer", CASE WHEN qr.QUIZ_CORRECT = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "is_correct", q.QUIZ_QUESTION AS "question", c.CATEGORY_ID AS "categoryId", c.CATEGORY_NAME AS "categoryName" FROM quiz_responses qr JOIN selfstudy_results sr ON qr.selfstudy_results_id = sr.selfstudy_results_id JOIN quiz_sessions qs ON sr.quiz_session_id = qs.quiz_session_id JOIN quizzes q ON q.quiz_id = qr.quiz_id AND q.quiz_session_id = qs.quiz_session_id JOIN subjects s ON qs.subject_id = s.subject_id JOIN categories c ON s.category_id = c.category_id WHERE sr.member_num = #{memberNum} ORDER BY c.category_id, sr.submitted_at, qr.quiz_responses_id

SELECT c.CATEGORY_ID AS "categoryId", sr.SELFSTUDY_RESULTS_ID AS "resultId", sr.SELFSTUDY_RESULTS_ID AS "round", sr.SELFSTUDY_TOTAL_SCORE AS "score", TO_CHAR(sr.SUBMITTED_AT, 'MM-DD') AS "date" FROM SELFSTUDY_RESULTS sr JOIN QUIZ_SESSIONS qs ON sr.QUIZ_SESSION_ID = qs.QUIZ_SESSION_ID JOIN SUBJECTS s ON qs.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID JOIN CATEGORIES c ON s.CATEGORY_ID = c.CATEGORY_ID WHERE sr.MEMBER_NUM = #{memberNum} ORDER BY sr.SUBMITTED_AT ASC, sr.SELFSTUDY_RESULTS_ID ASC

SELECT c.CATEGORY_ID AS "categoryId", c.CATEGORY_NAME AS "categoryName", COUNT(sr.SELFSTUDY_RESULTS_ID) AS "totalAttempts", NVL(AVG(sr.SELFSTUDY_TOTAL_SCORE), 0) AS "averageScore", MAX(sr.SELFSTUDY_TOTAL_SCORE) AS "maxScore", MIN(sr.SELFSTUDY_TOTAL_SCORE) AS "minScore" FROM SELFSTUDY_RESULTS sr JOIN QUIZ_SESSIONS qs ON sr.QUIZ_SESSION_ID = qs.QUIZ_SESSION_ID JOIN SUBJECTS s ON qs.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID JOIN CATEGORIES c ON s.CATEGORY_ID = c.CATEGORY_ID WHERE sr.MEMBER_NUM = #{memberNum} GROUP BY c.CATEGORY_ID, c.CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_NAME ASC

SELECT c.CATEGORY_ID AS "categoryId", s.SUBJECT_ID AS "subjectId", s.SUBJECT_NAME AS "name", COUNT(qr.QUIZ_RESPONSES_ID) AS "value" FROM QUIZ_RESPONSES qr JOIN QUIZZES q ON qr.QUIZ_ID = q.QUIZ_ID JOIN QUIZ_SESSIONS qs ON q.QUIZ_SESSION_ID = qs.QUIZ_SESSION_ID JOIN SUBJECTS s ON qs.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID JOIN CATEGORIES c ON s.CATEGORY_ID = c.CATEGORY_ID WHERE qs.MEMBER_NUM = #{memberNum} AND qr.QUIZ_CORRECT = 'N' GROUP BY c.CATEGORY_ID, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_NAME
